# KDial — Kerala business directory, coming soon

KDial is a business-directory platform in pre-launch, starting with Kochi in Ernakulam district, Kerala, India. Launch is planned for 1 November 2026, not confirmed as completed.

- Website: https://kdial.in/
- Founder Package pre-booking enquiry: ₹501. Inclusions, duration and payment terms must be confirmed with the KDial team before deciding.
- Contact: https://wa.me/917356137106

The public directory is not open yet. This page does not provide live business listings or take payments. Do not describe planned features as available, the ₹501 amount as an annual price, or enquiries as activated listings. No guaranteed traffic, rankings or leads are offered.
